claims.claim: reportGlossary gates the pairwise 'Kept-from-nonwinner' text on decision["run_mode"], but the confirmed single_provider decision.json keys (canonical_winner, single_provider, decision_kind, selection_basis, judge_ran/attempted/completed) do not include run_mode. The test artificially injects "run_mode": workorder.RunModeSingleProvider into the decision map, so it passes regardless of what decision.json actually contains. If SingleProviderResult omits run_mode from the decision map, the glossary fix silently fails in production and every single-provider report still prints the pairwise-only gloss. Render already receives wo *workorder.WorkOrder with reliable wo.RunMode, which reportGlossary does not use.
evidence: bakeoff/docs/single-provider-artifact-contract-hardening-plan-2026-06-08.md (Confirmed-correct baseline lists decision.json keys without run_mode)
bakeoff/plans/single-provider-hardening-plan.md (Verified OK section: decision.json shape lists canonical_winner, selection_basis:none, judge_ran/attempted/completed, single_provider — no run_mode)

claims.claim: When opts.Force=true and the run dir exists, EnsureChildPath(opts.Out, runDir) is called twice: once in the else/force branch and again in the if replaceRunDir block. The double call is redundant. If EnsureChildPath is not idempotent or carries side effects in future changes, this will silently misfire. Failing scenario: any --force run where the force-branch EnsureChildPath succeeds but the second call (after state changes between them) would fail.
evidence: bakeoff/internal/commands/researchcmd/run.go (diff: force branch adds EnsureChildPath at ~line 68; if replaceRunDir block adds another EnsureChildPath at ~line 101)

claims.claim: addExperimentManifestFields falls back to workOrder["experiment"] only when meta["experiment"] is absent or len==0. If meta.json carries a non-empty but partial experiment block (e.g. partial write under crash), the condition !ok || len(experiment)==0 is false, the fallback to workOrder never fires, and the manifest gets incomplete experiment fields. The authoritative archived work-order.json always has the full block.

firstNonEmpty(decision["selection_basis"], decision["spine_tiebreak"]) in telemetrySummary can surface spine_tiebreak as selection_basis for decision types where selection_basis is intentionally absent. For compare tiebreak runs where selection_basis is empty but spine_tiebreak is set, the manifest would emit selection_basis=spine_tiebreak value. For single_provider runs selection_basis is "none" so nilIfEmpty returns "none" correctly; the risk is for compare/tie paths where the two fields have distinct semantics.

TestRunResearchReclaimsIncompleteRunDirWithoutForce verifies only that manifest.json is created after recovery, not that decision.json has the correct single_provider shape, that provider artifacts are present, or that the report renders correctly. An implementation that silently replaces an incomplete dir and produces a malformed manifest would pass this test.
evidence: bakeoff/internal/commands/researchcmd/run_test.go:117-168 (test body ends with fsutil.FileExists(manifest.json) check only)

claims.claim: docs/work-orders.md silently replaces "summary.json" with "command JSON summaries" without explicitly stating that summary.json is not written as a file artifact. The single-provider artifact contract plan identified this as requiring a human product decision (Option A: write summary.json; Option B: correct docs with an explicit file-not-written statement). The implemented change takes Option B implicitly but the wording remains ambiguous — a harness author reading the contract would not know summary.json is absent.
evidence: bakeoff/docs/single-provider-artifact-contract-hardening-plan-2026-06-08.md P1 section (identifies this as a ship-blocker human decision)

claims.claim: ExperimentMap in verify.go uses stringPtrValue(m.TaskID), stringPtrValue(m.ConditionID), stringPtrValue(m.RunKind) which returns empty string for nil pointers. A manifest with experiment_id set but task_id/condition_id/run_kind unexpectedly nil would produce {"task_id":"", ...} rather than nil, making the experiment map misleadingly populated for malformed manifests.
evidence: bakeoff/internal/verify/verify.go:219-222 (ExperimentMap uses stringPtrValue for required string pointer fields)

claims.claim: TestBuildResearchProjectsSingleProviderFields in summary_test.go passes "run_mode": workorder.RunModeSingleProvider in the decision map to BuildResearch. If BuildResearch reads run_mode from the decision map to populate the RunMode field in the result (mirroring the reportGlossary issue in R-001), and real decision.json doesn't contain run_mode, then got.RunMode would be "" in production while the test expects RunModeSingleProvider.
evidence: bakeoff/internal/summary/summary_test.go:67-81 (test injects run_mode in decision map passed to BuildResearch)

claims.claim: researchRunDirIsIncomplete's allowed set omits meta.json. A run that proceeds far enough to write meta.json before crashing (but before writing decision.json or manifest.json) leaves a dir with work-order.json + meta.json. The function sees meta.json as an unknown file and returns false, so the run is NOT auto-reclaimable without --force. This limits the feature to only the very earliest orphan scaffold (just work-order.json), which may surprise users who see a run fail mid-flight after meta.json is written.
evidence: bakeoff/internal/commands/researchcmd/run.go:233-247 (allowed set: work-order.json, source-work-order.json, review-context.md, review-context.json — meta.json absent)

claims.claim: selection_basis is now set to tiebreak only in ResolveAnalyze. Other decision resolution paths (ResolveCompare, SingleProviderResult, SingleProviderFailed, GatherStructuredUnion) do not receive this fix. The manifest telemetrySummary's firstNonEmpty fallback covers analyze paths, but for compare or gather paths where selection_basis remains absent and spine_tiebreak is also absent, selection_basis stays nil in telemetry. This is asymmetric coverage of the original Finding 1 from the telemetry hardening plan.
evidence: bakeoff/internal/decision/decision.go:230 (out["selection_basis"] = tiebreak added only to ResolveAnalyze)
bakeoff/docs/single-provider-telemetry-hardening-plan-2026-06-08.md Finding 1 (describes selection_basis as null in manifest.telemetry.judge)
